title: 36 Hours in San Francisco
abstract: As beautiful as ever, this glittering bayside city is expanding its public spaces and arts institutions.

title: 36 Hours in Atlanta
abstract: This Southern hub of creativity, nightlife and civil rights history is showing it has an outdoorsy side too, with the Beltline, a popular biking and walking path.

title: 36 Hours in Tucson, Ariz.
abstract: Stargaze from desert observatories, try traditional Sonoran spirits and hit the local trails in Arizona’s mountain-ringed second city.

title: 36 Hours in Honolulu
abstract: Explore lush forest trails, midcentury architecture and tropical flavors in Hawaii’s multicultural capital.
